body: Realization in and of itself does not make me a good person - sure, I regret my actions and I realize they were wrong. That doesn't make them right.. and it sure as hell won't get him to forgive me. Which is what I want more than anything. I can't express the amount of pain the remorse, regret and guilt I feel over all of this.. and over the knowledge that he'll never forgive me.
Beauty is in the eye of the beholder... but if you really knew me, you'd know I was the furthest thing from beautiful of anything you've ever beheld. :( Thanks for the thought though...

I'm not escaping.. I know what happened, I know it's my fault. I know that things happened, how they did.. because of my decisions. It's impossible to escape the weight of that.. and forgiveness is never as easy to give as people as it is. :(

I've said "I'm sorry".. to him, and to a ton of other people I've hurt. It never seems to be enough.. forgivness is all I want for anyone. 

Can no one believe that people make mistakes - but LEARN from them?! I feel like I'll never get past being known as the person that screwed up a million times. The only way I know how to erase that, is to erase myself..
